# Fast_Response_Actuator

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
An actuator designed to achieve rapid mechanical response times (e.g., milliseconds) suitable for real-time interactive feedback. Enables real-time closed-loop control in iNEST systems, where timing precision is essential for mimicking biological reflexes.
